items.title: Identify Economic and Non-Economic Activities
items.explanation: Economic activities involve money, exchange for goods/services, or monetary value (e.g., a pilot receiving salary, a teacher earning a fee). Non-economic activities do not generate income but are done out of feelings like gratitude, love, care, or respect (e.g., volunteering to teach computer skills, helping neighbors with sewing). Both types contribute to society's daily life.
